crossRefs.note: He sent two of his disciples, and said to them, “Go into the city, and there you will meet a man carrying a pitcher of…
They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.
But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.”…
But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,
that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”
translations.bsb: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover.”
translations.kjv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat.
translations.asv: And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make ready for us the passover, that we may eat.
